product.name: Monoprice SSW-8 8in 100-Watt Powered Slim Subwoofer
product.description: The Monoprice™ SSW‑8 is a 8" 100‑watt powered subwoofer that helps alleviate subwoofer placement in any room. This slim, low profile ported subwoofer can be placed under your favorite chair, behind your TV stand, or under your sofa. The subwoofer includes on‑wall mounting brackets, allowing you place it on the wall, if you prefer.
